description: This file defines a React component 'MixedChart' that renders a customizable mixed chart (line and bar) using react-chartjs-2 and Chart.js. It includes configuration, styling, and dynamic dataset processing.

classes.name: MixedChart
classes.description: React functional component for rendering a mixed chart with configurable datasets, styles, and optional header information.

methods.name: MixedChart
methods.description: Main React component function that manages chart data state, processes datasets, and renders the chart with optional header.
